rate_path.rationale: The Committee held the federal funds rate at 0 to 1/4 percent and expected exceptionally low levels to persist at least through late 2014, as part of its forward guidance at the time of the meeting. The reference to 'late 2014' is a projection made in the minutes and is not post-release.
